messages:
vini: Quick idea — allow clients to send an X-Model-Preference header (e.g. "7b-q4", "lucid-13b") and treat it as a negotiation hint that the gateway can reconcile with tenant / route pins. Use-case: customer prefers cheaper quantized model but can accept larger fallback if feature-incompatible.

ana: Hmm. Do we want to treat that as a hard preference or just a soft hint? If tenant pinned a specific alias, we should never override it.

leo: Prototype config i sketched:
```
route:
  match:
    path_prefix: /v1/generate
    header:
      X-Model-Preference: prefer-7b
  model_selection:
    alias_candidates: ["lucid-7b-q4", "lucid-13b"]
    negotiation: soft # soft|strict
    compatibility_checks: ["kv-cache", "rope-pos"]
    telemetry_tags: ["negotiation_hint"]
```

sara: Telemetry question — if gateway picks a non-preferred model we should tag emissions so Optimize can surface regression/cost impact. Also quota: pref->fallback should still debit from the route's quota bucket, not the model's owner bucket.

vlad: Agreed re: telemetry & quota. UX ask for Console: show a small timeline in route details that says "client hint accepted / rejected" with reason (compat, pin, regional capacity). CC @ana @leo to design fields.

ana: For compatibility checks, how deep do we go? E.g. does `rope-pos` mismatch count as incompatible or do we have graceful shim? I'd rather have configurable bailouts: reject, fallback, degrade.

leo: We can reuse the selector DSL but add a negotiation phase. Pseudocode:
```
selected = resolve_pin(route, tenant)
if not selected:
  candidates = expand_aliases(hint || route.aliases)
  selected = pick_by_compat(candidates, request_features)
  if not selected and route.fallback_policy == "allow_upgrade":
    selected = best_compatible(candidates)
```

sara: Also flagging rate-limit complexity — if a hint leads to an upgrade (cheaper->expensive) we need automatic cost alerts and maybe a soft cap until admin approves.

vlad: Ops note: deploy-bot will roll this out as experimental behind a feature-flag. We'll gate by org and add a canary dashboard (negotiation acceptance %, avg token delta).

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for feature-flag `model-negotiation`. 5 orgs -> 10% traffic. Monitor `routing.negotiation.*` metrics.

vini: Next steps:
- leo: prototype selector changes + unit tests
- ana: Console viz mock and fields
- sara: telemetry + quota mapping plan
- vlad: rollout gating & rollout policy

vini: If everyone ok, i'll create a RFC PR with the config API and an example curl test.

sara: +1 from me. :+1:

ana: +1, will help wire up UX copy.

leo: will start tomorrow, dropping draft PR by EOD Friday.
